name: Akira-Seiki Performa CNC Vertical Machining Center
blurb: CNC milling and drilling, with Kurt vises on the table.
text: Akira-Seiki Performa CNC vertical machining center. It mills and drills parts under CNC control, with Kurt vises on the table to hold the work.
imageAlt: White and gray CNC machine with double doors, a control panel with a screen and a handwheel, and a blue Kurt vise visible through the window

features.name: Milling
features.text: Cutting flats, slots, pockets and contours in a part.

features.name: Drilling
features.text: Making holes at the positions set in the CNC program.

features.name: CNC control
features.text: A screen, keypad and handwheel at the front of the machine.

features.name: Workholding
features.text: Kurt vises on the table clamp the workpiece.

features.name: Enclosed work area
features.text: Double doors with windows close off the cutting area.

name: Sharp 22120B Engine Lathe
blurb: Engine lathe with a digital readout for turning, boring, facing, knurling and drilling.
text: Sharp 22120B engine lathe with a Newall digital readout. It turns, bores, faces, knurls and drills cylindrical parts.
imageAlt: Long lathe bed with a chuck, a tailstock and a digital readout, bar stock racked behind

features.name: Turning
features.text: Cutting a rotating workpiece to a diameter or contour.

features.name: Boring
features.text: Enlarging or finishing an existing hole.

features.name: Facing
features.text: Cutting the end of a workpiece flat.

features.name: Knurling
features.text: Pressing a pattern into the surface for grip.

features.name: Drilling
features.text: Making holes along the axis of the workpiece.

name: Flow Mach 3 4020b Waterjet
blurb: Cold cutting of sheet and plate, with no heat-affected zone.
text: Flow Mach 3 4020b waterjet cutting machine. A waterjet cuts sheet and plate with a high-pressure stream of water, a cold process that does not heat the material.
imageAlt: Large cutting table with a gantry carrying the C&M shop sign, in a corrugated-steel shop

features.name: Cold cutting
features.text: The cut adds no heat, so there is no heat-affected zone.

features.name: Sheet and plate
features.text: Cuts flat sheet and plate to the outline in your drawing.

features.name: Heat-sensitive materials
features.text: Suits materials that should not be heated.

name: Fiber Laser Cutting System
blurb: Cutting sheet metal such as stainless steel, aluminum, brass and mild steel.
text: Enclosed fiber laser cutting system with a long slatted cutting table in front of the enclosure. It cuts sheet metal such as stainless steel, aluminum, brass and mild steel.
imageAlt: Black enclosure with a long slatted cutting table and a dust collector with six round filters

features.name: Sheet metal cutting
features.text: Stainless steel, aluminum, brass and mild steel.

features.name: Slatted cutting table
features.text: A long slatted table extends in front of the black enclosure.

features.name: Dust collection
features.text: A six-filter dust collector stands beside the machine.

name: Timesavers 32 RB Series Wide-Belt Finishing Machine
blurb: Deburring and finishing metal parts with abrasive belts.
text: Timesavers 32 RB Series wide-belt finishing machine. It deburrs and finishes metal parts with abrasive belts.
imageAlt: White wide-belt machine with a dark safety door, a touch-screen control panel and a conveyor table extending to the right

features.name: Deburring
features.text: Removes burrs and sharp edges left by cutting.

features.name: Finishing
features.text: Smooths the surface of metal parts with abrasive belts.

features.name: Enclosed work area
features.text: A safety door and a touch-screen control panel.
